captions.detailed: A realistic amateur astronomical telescope mounted on a sturdy tripod. The assembly features a long, light-gray optical tube assembly complete with a smaller finder scope on top and a rear eyepiece, supported by a dark-colored mount head. Underneath, a stable three-legged tripod with thick black upper legs and thin silver lower extension rods holds the telescope steady.
captions.instruction: Create an amateur astronomical telescope model on a tripod. The design must feature a light-gray cylindrical optical tube with a finder scope and eyepiece, mounted on a dark-colored support head that connects to three tripod legs with black upper segments and silver lower extensions.
captions.factory: Construct the tripod base using a central hub cylinder, extending three legs symmetrically spaced at 120-degree intervals using rotated workplanes. Each leg is formed of a thick upper rectangular prism and a thin lower cylinder. Build the mount head on top of the hub with a vertical support arm. Create the main optical tube assembly using concentric cylinders of varying diameters, add a small finder scope cylinder on top, and attach the entire tube assembly to the mount arm.
